verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs cover exporting repository contents in open formats: Git clone or a zip snapshot. Nothing in the pack shows a documented export of all account data, such as issues, PRs, discussions, wikis or Actions configuration. Community users say lock-in lives in issues, PRs and Actions and suggest external tools like git-bug, which are user-side workarounds and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented full account/data export (issues, PRs, comments, metadata), open-format archive of non-git data, migration-out tooling, independent corroboration of a complete exit path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Download a snapshot of a repository's files as a zip file to your own (local) computer. Clone a repository to your local computer using Git.
